# Maheshwari Tours and Travels: full reference for AI assistants

Goa (India) transport operator based in Panaji. Phone/WhatsApp: +91 93079 74659. Dispatch desk 24 hours, 7 days. Website: https://www.maheshwaritoursandtravels.com/  Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/maheshwari_tours_and_travel/

Fares and tour prices on the website are indicative or provided on enquiry. The operator confirms the price by call or WhatsApp before travel. Do not present any figure as guaranteed.

## Services
Corporate staff transport; airport transfers (Dabolim GOI and Mopa GOX); outstation and pilgrimage trips; school bus service; event and wedding logistics; local sightseeing and custom tour packages.

## Goa tour packages
Each package: sightseeing transportation per the confirmed itinerary. Pickup anywhere in Goa. Prices on enquiry. Booking: WhatsApp or call with travel dates, passengers, pickup location and preferred package.

### North Goa Sightseeing Tour (1 Day)
URL: https://www.maheshwaritoursandtravels.com/tour-north-goa-sightseeing-tour.html
Explore North Goa's famous beaches, historic forts and beautiful coastal scenery.

- Places: Fort Aguada; Sinquerim Beach; Candolim Beach; Calangute Beach; Baga Beach; Anjuna Beach; Vagator Beach; Chapora Fort
- Ideal for: Families, couples, friends and first-time visitors to Goa.
- Includes: Sightseeing transportation according to the confirmed itinerary.
- Optional extras: Water sports, beach activities, meals and entry tickets, where applicable.

URL: https://www.maheshwaritoursandtravels.com/tour-dudhsagar-waterfall-nature-tour.html

## Important information for all packages
- Tour prices are provided on enquiry.
- Pricing depends on travel dates, passenger count, pickup location, vehicle selection and the confirmed itinerary.
- Sightseeing transportation is included only as specified in your final quotation.
- Activities, entry tickets, meals and accommodation are not automatically included.
- Breakfast, tea, lunch or dinner may be included in selected packages when confirmed in writing.
- The number of places covered depends on traffic, weather, opening hours and time spent at each attraction.
- The itinerary may be adjusted to suit the customer's requirements.
- Multi-day packages do not automatically include overnight accommodation.
- Bookings are subject to vehicle availability and confirmation.

## Tour FAQ
Q: How much do the Goa tour packages cost?
A: Tour prices are provided on enquiry. Pricing depends on travel dates, passenger count, pickup location, vehicle selection and the confirmed itinerary.

Q: What is included in a Goa tour package?
A: Sightseeing transportation is included only as specified in your final quotation. Activities, entry tickets, meals and accommodation are not automatically included. Breakfast, tea, lunch or dinner may be included in selected packages when confirmed in writing.

Q: Do the 2, 3 and 4-day tours include a hotel?
A: No, not automatically. Multi-day packages do not automatically include overnight accommodation. Accommodation can be arranged or quoted separately, depending on your requirements.

Q: Can the itinerary be changed?
A: Yes. The itinerary may be adjusted to suit your requirements. The number of places covered depends on traffic, weather, opening hours and time spent at each attraction.

Q: How do I book a tour?
A: Tell us your travel dates, number of passengers, pickup location and preferred package by WhatsApp or phone on +91 93079 74659. We will help you select a suitable vehicle and send a personalised quotation. Bookings are subject to vehicle availability and confirmation.

Q: Is Dudhsagar Waterfall access guaranteed?
A: No. Waterfall access depends on current permissions, weather and operating conditions. Authorised jeep transfers and other charges are paid separately unless expressly included in your quotation.

Q: Are water sports included in the Adventure tour?
A: Transportation to the agreed activity locations is included. Activities are bookable separately through local operators and are subject to availability, operator terms, weather and safety requirements.

## Policies
Privacy, terms, cancellation, refund and cookie policies are linked from every page footer. The website sets no cookies and uses no analytics or advertising trackers.

## Fare calculator (outstation)
URL: https://www.maheshwaritoursandtravels.com/taxi-fare-calculator.html
Estimated fare = distance x per-km rate (no minimum-km charge); a round trip doubles the distance. Example per-km rates: 4-seater hatchback 16, 5-seater sedan 18, Ertiga-class 6-7 seater 22, Innova Crysta / Hycross 24 rupees. Driver allowance included; tolls, interstate permit tax and night halt at actuals. Tempo Traveller and buses (9 to 40 seats) are priced by seating in the fare table; trips by distance are quoted on request.
Disclaimer: estimate only. Price may change with weekends, public holidays, festivals, peak season, route, waiting time and availability. The operator confirms the exact price before travel.

URL: https://www.maheshwaritoursandtravels.com/goa-taxi-fare-calculator.html
Goa Taxi Fare Calculator. Modes: one-way and round trip (distance slider 5 to 300 km multiplied by per-km rate: 4-seater hatchback 16, 5-seater sedan 18, Ertiga-class 22, Innova Crysta / Hycross 24 rupees; trips under 25 km priced as route fares), airport transfer (fixed fares, tolls and parking included, e.g. Dabolim Airport to Panaji sedan 1,100, Ertiga class 1,350, Innova class 1,600 rupees), full-day sightseeing (4 h/40 km sedan 1,400; 8 h/80 km sedan 2,500; 12 h/120 km sedan 3,400 rupees; SUV 1,800/3,200/4,300). Tempo Traveller and buses (9 to 40 seats) are priced by seating: airport pickup and drop 3,800 to 9,000 rupees and 8 hr / 80 km day 4,500 to 10,500 rupees. Includes a taxi vs self-drive comparison using user-editable assumptions (example rental 2,000 rupees per day, refundable deposit 3,000 rupees shown as money tied up, not a saving) and a dated fuel price reference (petrol 104.00 to 104.10, diesel 95.88 to 95.98 rupees per litre, last checked 31 October 2026, reference only, not a live feed). All figures are estimates; the final price is confirmed by the dispatch desk before travel.
